# NodeDots

NodeDots is the portfolio of @nodedots, a developer building simple tools that help people make better decisions around trust, clarity, and AI.

## Core Principle

Explain first, then invite action.

## Products

- VennURL: a free web app that shows what is behind a link before someone clicks it.
- Tabmeet: a browser tool that turns scattered open tabs into tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations.
- Third product: coming soon.

## Useful Pages

- X: https://x.com/nodedots
